svg.aria-label: Left: running means of three Cauchy sequences keep jumping even after 5000 observations, while the normal running mean settles at zero. Right: for autocorrelated data the true standard error exceeds the naive s over root n by the factor root of (1 plus rho) over (1 minus rho), three times larger at rho 0.8
